editorial:
Imagine living in a house where you have to keep everything perfectly clean just to avoid a fight. That is the scary world Laura lives in with her husband, Martin. He seems like a perfect guy to the outside world, but behind closed doors, he is a controlling monster. You will feel your heart race when Laura finally decides she has had enough and fakes her own death in a dramatic boating accident. She moves to a new town, changes her name, and starts over, but the scary part is knowing that a man like Martin never truly gives up.

Julia Roberts does a great job showing both the fear and the hope of a woman trying to find her freedom. The movie keeps you on edge because you know it is only a matter of time before he finds her. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the tension makes it a fun ride. It is a solid pick for a rainy weekend.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a final, scary showdown at Laura's new home. Martin finds her and tries to take her back by force. In a desperate fight for her life, Laura uses her knowledge of the house to fight back. She eventually manages to kill Martin to protect herself and her new life. The film wraps up with Laura finally being safe and free from his control, knowing she can finally breathe again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves suspenseful stories about escaping a bad situation.
